head.name: Crown of Parallax
head.label: PARALLAX
head.description: The forked crest frames a panoramic sensor head that reads the void in stereo.
details: Panoramic visor and cheek sensor pods

torso.name: Sovereign Heart
torso.label: SOVEREIGN
torso.description: A sealed Minovsky reactor sits behind the chest vents. Its pulse is the only thing the pilot hears when the cockpit goes dark.

backpack.name: Seraph of the Outer Dark
backpack.label: SERAPH
backpack.description: A dorsal vernier pack that turns silent drift into an abrupt change of heading. On VK‑07, the wing binders flare open around it.
details: Independent left and right attitude trim

legs.name: Atlas Gravewalkers
legs.label: ATLAS
legs.description: Armored legs with calf verniers and reinforced ankles. Built to touch down as if the moon had flinched first.

rifle.name: Eventide Lance
rifle.label: EVENTIDE
rifle.description: A long-frame beam rifle with a silhouette the hangar crew calls the Last Light.
details: Vented frame and long emitter shroud

shield.name: Eclipse Reliquary
shield.label: ECLIPSE
shield.description: A tall, layered forearm shield named for the shadow it casts across the frame.

left-shoulder.name: Bastion of the Pale Moon
left-shoulder.label: BASTION
left-shoulder.description: Overlapping armor floats over the left shoulder, keeping the joint covered through a full shield-side turn.

right-shoulder.name: Titan's Oath
right-shoulder.label: TITAN
right-shoulder.description: The right pauldron rises with the arm, leaving the joint clear while still carrying the frame's identification plate.

antenna.name: Ghost Choir
antenna.label: CHOIR
antenna.description: Twin antennae listen for fleet beacons through the Minovsky haze. Pilots say the two channels never fall silent at the same time.

arms.name: Adamant Grasp
arms.label: ADAMANT
arms.description: Articulated wrists and segmented hands built to handle everything from a hangar tether to the suit's own shield.
